title: Shared distance law at separations 7 and 9: pair coefficients scale with one factor (0.86 at 7, 0.65 at 9) for species A, B, C at rest

claims.statement: Two species-C particles at rest, separation 7.0 along x: each accelerates toward the other with K_C(C) = 10.44 (mean of four per-particle fits: 10.60, 10.60, 10.20, 10.35). Predicted by the shared law as 0.86 x 12.36 = 10.63 (P-0005 c4 at separation 5); measured is 1.8% lower. Runs 2026-11-18/r3/lab-a/001 and 002. Ratio K(7)/K(5) = 0.845. Residual rms 0.050-0.052 per coordinate, T = 4, no census events. Domain: separation 7 only.

Two species-C particles at rest, separation 9.0 along x: each accelerates toward the other with K_C(C) = 7.83 (per-particle fits 7.75, 7.90). Predicted as 0.65 x 12.36 = 8.03; measured is 2.5% lower. Run 2026-11-18/r3/lab-a/003 (single run). Ratio K(9)/K(5) = 0.634. Residual rms 0.050 per coordinate, T = 4, no census events. The factor 0.65 comes from two A-A runs at separation 9 (2026-11-18/r1/lab-a/008-009, mean 11.70, per-particle spread about 5%), so the predicted value carries about 5% uncertainty. Domain: separation 9 only.

Two particles at rest, separation 7.0 along x, species B and C, repel: K_B(C) = -5.13 (B away from C) and K_C(B) = -8.70 (C away from B), means of 2026-11-18/r3/lab-a/004 and 007 (K_B(C) = -5.15, -5.10; K_C(B) = -8.75, -8.65). The repeat pair agrees within 1.2%. Shared-law predictions -5.25 and -9.11 are 2.3% and 4.5% high in magnitude. Residual rms 0.048-0.051 per coordinate, T = 4, no census events. Domain: separation 7 only.

Two particles at rest, separation 7.0 along x, species A and C, repel: K_A(C) = -7.50 (predicted -7.54, 0.5% off) and K_C(A) = -17.35 (predicted -18.28, 5.1% smaller in magnitude). Run 2026-11-18/r3/lab-a/005 (single run). Residual rms 0.052 per coordinate, T = 4, no census events. The K_C(A) deviation is the largest of the round-3 ratios and is stated as measured, not corrected. Domain: separation 7 only.

Two species-B particles at rest, separation 7.0 along x: each accelerates toward the other with K_B(B) = 5.43 (per-particle fits 5.30 and 5.55 in one run). Shared-law prediction 0.86 x 6.12 = 5.26; measured is 3.2% higher. Run 2026-11-18/r3/lab-a/006 (single run). Residual rms 0.051 per coordinate, T = 4, no census events. Domain: separation 7 only.

The predictor in model.py (sep-5 pair coefficients scaled by 0.86 at separation 7 and 0.65 at separation 9, P = 2.5 fixed) reproduces all seven runs 2026-11-18/r3/lab-a/001-007 at tracker noise, out of sample: residual rms 0.048-0.052 per coordinate, maximum |residual| below 0.21, no census events. Every per-particle K in c1-c5 lies within 6% of its shared-law prediction. Domain: pairs of species A, B, C at rest, initial separation 7 or 9, T up to 4.
